news.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high on inflation, spending concerns
news.summary: U.S. 30-year Treasury yields add over 1 basis point to trade at around 5.322%, hovering just below its highest level since 2002.

news.title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid 'frozen housing market conditions'
news.summary: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines. Home Depot: Second fiscal quarter Results beat Wall St. expectations.

news.title: American Airlines to add seatback screens, bigger first class in race to catch up to Delta and United
news.summary: American is trying to add more premium seating and passenger perks. The airline has fallen behind rivals Delta and United in terms of premium seating. American is also trying to attract more women to its flights.

news.title: Contrarian vs. the crowd: One trader made a massive bet against chip stocks
news.summary: The biggest single options trade in the entire market Monday was a $129 million bet against the VanEck Semiconductor ETF. The bet was made by a single investor.

news.title: Stocks keep shrugging off rising Treasury yields. Here’s the level that could finally trigger a selloff.
news.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield continues to climb. Strategas says that ascent will be much higher before stocks start to hurt. The call of the day from Strategas is that stocks will continue to rise.
